heading: Art. 92. Failure to obey order or regulation
lead: Any person subject to this chapter who— shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

tree.text: violates or fails to obey any lawful general order or regulation;
having knowledge of any other lawful order issued by a member of the armed forces, which it is his duty to obey, fails to obey the order; or
is derelict in the performance of his duties;

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 89250:686.May 5, 1950, ch. 169, § 1 (Art. 92), 64 Stat. 136. The word “order” is substituted for the word “same”.
